name: TaxMCP
description: TaxMCP connects Claude to a searchable tax-law knowledge base covering the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury Regulations, IRS publications and guidance, U.S. Tax Court opinions, and supported state tax statutes. Seven read-only tools let users search tax topics, retrieve exact sections and source documents, explore cross-references, and review case citation activity. Results include source metadata and citation URLs so tax professionals can verify the underlying authority. Federal search is available on all plans; case law, advanced guidance, and state-law access depend on the connected TaxMCP plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TaxMCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TaxMCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.taxmcp.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TaxMCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TaxMCP provides these MCP tools: get-case-tool, get-citing-cases-tool, get-cross-references-tool, get-publication-tool, get-ruling-tool, lookup-section-tool, and search-tax-law-tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TaxMCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to TaxMCP in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
TaxMCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TaxMCP is developed by TaxMCP. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
